title: राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमप्रति शिक्षकहरूका प्रतिक्रिया Rashtriya Prarambhik Kakshya Padhai Karyakramprati Shikshakharuka Pratikriya
nepali: राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रम नेपालका आधारभूत तह (कक्षा १–३) का विद्यार्थीहरूको पढाइ क्षमता सुधारका लागि कार्यान्वयनमा ल्याइएको कार्यक्रम हो । यो कार्यक्रम विभिन्न चरणमा कार्यान्वयन हुँदै आएको पाइन्छ । साथै यसको शैक्षणिक प्रभावकारिता पनि निकै अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । यही वस्तुतालाई हृदयङ्गम गरी प्रस्तुत लेख तयार परिएको छ । विशेषतः प्रस्तुत लेख राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमप्रति शिक्षकहरूका प्रतिक्रियाको अध्ययनमा आधारित रहेको छ । यस लेखमा राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमको चिनारीसहित यसप्रति अध्यापनरत शिक्षकहरूका प्रतिक्रियाको अध्ययन विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमको परिचय दिनु र यसप्रति अध्यापनरत शिक्षकहरूका प्रतिक्रियाहरूको अध्ययन गर्नु यस लेखका मूलभूत उद्देश्यका रूपमा रहेका छन् । प्रस्तुत अध्ययन मूलतः गुणात्मक अनुसन्धानमा आधारित रहेको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनका क्रममा भक्तपुर जिल्लामा अध्यापनरत शिक्षकहरूलाई नमुनाका रूपमा लिई अध्ययनका क्रममा आधारभूत तहमा अध्यापनरत उहाँहरूको प्रतिक्रिया लिइएको छ । यसका लागि खुला प्रश्नावलीको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस लेखमा शिक्षकहरूबाट प्राप्त तथ्यहरूको सूक्ष्म समीक्षण गरिएको छ । साथै प्राप्त तथ्यहरूलाई व्याख्यात्मक एवम् विश्लेषणात्मक विधिका माध्यमबाट प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english: The National Early Grade Reading Program is an initiative implemented to improve the reading ability of students at the basic level (grades 1–3) in Nepal. This program has reportedly been implemented in multiple phases. In addition, high instructional effectiveness has been widely anticipated from it. Keeping this reality in mind, the present article was prepared. Specifically, this article is based on an investigation of teachers' reactions toward the National Early Grade Reading Program. In this article, an analytical study of the reactions of teachers working under the National Early Grade Reading Program is carried out alongside an introduction to the program. Providing an overview of the National Early Grade Reading Program and examining the reactions of the teachers instructing within it serve as the fundamental objectives of this article. The present study is essentially grounded in qualitative research. During this study, teachers working in Bhaktapur district were selected as a sample, and their reactions while teaching at the basic level were gathered. An open-ended questionnaire was utilized for this purpose. In this article, a close review of the data obtained from the teachers has been conducted. Additionally, the findings obtained have been presented through descriptive and analytical methods.
british_english: The National Early Grade Reading Programme is a programme implemented to improve the reading ability of pupils at the basic level (classes 1–3) in Nepal. This programme is seen to have been rolled out in distinct phases. Furthermore, considerable pedagogical efficacy has been expected of it. Mindful of this reality, the present article has been prepared. In particular, the present article is grounded in a study of teachers' responses to the National Early Grade Reading Programme. In this article, an introductory overview of the National Early Grade Reading Programme is provided, alongside an analytical study of the responses of teachers engaged in delivering it. Giving an introduction to the National Early Grade Reading Programme and investigating the responses of practising teachers towards it constitute the principal aims of this article. The present study is fundamentally based upon qualitative research. In the course of the present study, teachers instructing in Bhaktapur district were taken as a sample, and their feedback whilst teaching at the basic level was obtained. An open questionnaire was employed for this purpose. In this article, a detailed appraisal of the data gathered from the teachers has been carried out. Moreover, the evidence obtained has been presented by means of explanatory and analytical methods.
australian_english: The National Early Grade Reading Program is a programme rolled out to boost the reading skills of students in the primary years (classes 1–3) in Nepal. It turns out this programme has been implemented across several stages. As well as that, there have been high hopes for its teaching effectiveness. Taking this situation on board, the present article was put together. In particular, this article is based on a study looking at how teachers have responded to the National Early Grade Reading Program. This paper sets out an introduction to the National Early Grade Reading Program and works through an analysis of the feedback from teachers working with it. Introducing the National Early Grade Reading Program and examining the responses of teachers teaching under it are the core aims of this article. This study is mainly based on qualitative research. In doing the study, teachers working in Bhaktapur district were taken as a sample, and their feedback while teaching at the primary level was collected. An open-ended questionnaire was used for this. In this paper, a thorough check of the data gathered from the teachers has been carried out. As well, the findings gathered have been set out using descriptive and analytical methods.
informal_english: The National Early Grade Reading Programme is a scheme brought in to sort out the reading skills of young ones in the early grades (classes 1–3) across Nepal, so it is. It’s been rolled out in a good few stages over time, as it happens. And sure, folk have been expecting great things from it in the classroom too. With that very thing in mind, this article was put together. Mainly, this piece is built around what the teachers themselves had to say about the National Early Grade Reading Programme. In this paper, you get an introduction to the National Early Grade Reading Programme along with a proper look into the feedback from the teachers doing the actual teaching. Introducing the National Early Grade Reading Programme and seeing what the teachers taking the classes make of it are the main points of the whole paper. The study itself is pretty much built on qualitative research through and through. For the study, teachers working in Bhaktapur district were taken as the sample, and we gathered their thoughts while they were teaching away at the basic level. An open questionnaire was used to get the answers, so it was. In this paper, all the facts gathered from the teachers get a good, close going-over. On top of that, what came out of it has been laid out in an explanatory and analytical way.
translator_notes: Strict 12-sentence order preserved. Source contains minor typographic error 'तयार परिएको छ' (तयार पारिएको छ). National Early Grade Reading Program (राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रम), class levels (1–3), and Bhaktapur district preserved.
